success: verify all models/results/SHA; sync local evidence; update reports/status; local commit; push nonblocking; no active workers; /usr/bin/shutdown
hard_failure: preserve evidence; failure report; local sync/commit; no active workers; shutdown
waiting_for_user: question/block report; WAITING_FOR_USER; 1800-second timeout from first wait; no protocol changes; safe closeout then shutdown
healthy_long_workers: never classify elapsed runtime as idle
transport_outage_fallback: After 30 minutes without local closeout acknowledgement and no workers: archive full remote evidence, explicitly record sync pending, shutdown to prevent indefinite idle billing.
